short_experiment.interpretation: No stable gain in the warmed prefix-only experiment; the last control was slightly faster. It does not qualify a universal decode optimization. The old driver also propagated its long-prefill hint into decode; the final diagnostic fixes that, so server evidence is authoritative.
short_experiment.early_prototype_note: The first local prototype replaced the lookahead-loop bound as well as the hint bound. All ten decode routes fit one group, so it read no extra future expert in these cases. The unintended replacement was removed before both full server pairs.
